_doc: Spawn-site allowlist for scripts/lint-spawn-site.py (Router Core spec v5 §7.1, card t_3ca3dbc6). Each row grandfathers up to `count` spawns of (path, scope, kind) that do not go through alloc_client / placement.admit, until `expires`. The seeded rows are the Card B cutover inventory. Never add a row for new code; the lint fails a stale row, so the list only shrinks.
